scope: Local Windows and WSL Linux npm test and npm run verify in apps/idol-site.

provenance.baseline: The site/v207 release receipt pins the application hash, failure totals and verify exits. The archived Linux run also contains its commit marker.
provenance.win: The full suite used the Windows working tree after the final two runtime file changes, as confirmed by the run owner. The verification command was independently rerun for the committed candidate.
provenance.linux: The final WSL run is from a detached checkout corroborated by final-1d2236f8/linux-commit. Results from the earlier e89e1e21 run are excluded.

caseIdentity: A failed case uses suite, repository-relative source test file, and TAP title. Outcome census uses suite, title, and same-title occurrence. Python normal and optimized runs are reported separately.
